scripts.build: yarn workspace @space-lens/cli build && yarn workspace web build && bun build src/backend.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/backend.js --external space-lens && node scripts/copy-web-assets.mjs
scripts.build:backend: yarn workspace @space-lens/cli build && bun build src/backend.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/backend.js --external space-lens && node scripts/copy-web-assets.mjs --scanner-only
